latin: Elementa in octo coeli corporibus coelesti modo bis inueniuntur, quae quis inueniet si retrogrado ordine in illa bina numeratione processerit.
translation: The elements are found twice over, in a celestial mode, in the eight heavenly bodies — as anyone will discover who proceeds in reverse order through that twofold enumeration.
